BrochureContent.Content:
No. 52 Rushbrooke Manor is a beautifully presented three-bedroom semi-detached home with a rear extension and landscaped south-facing rear garden, ideally located within walking distance of Cobh town centre and all local amenities.

This bright and welcoming home offers spacious accommodation throughout and is perfectly suited to first-time buyers, families, or those looking to downsize.

Upon entering, you are welcomed by a comfortable living room featuring a solid wood burning hota stove surrounding by solid oak shelving units, leading through to a modern open- plan kitchen and dining area. The kitchen has been finished to a high standard and features a stylish contemporary design with Neff ovens and hob, and an AEG dishwasher. The property underwent extensive renovation works in 2018, including the addition of the rear extension and the installation of new windows throughout, creating a bright and energy-efficient living space. The BER rate is C , the house was built in 2003 and measures 93Sqm and the BER number is 119475184

The ground floor also benefits from a utility room and downstairs bathroom, while double doors open onto a beautifully landscaped south-facing rear garden, ideal for outdoor dining and entertaining. Beautiful solid oak internal doors feature throughout the home, complemented by attractive oak panelling beneath the staircase, adding warmth and character to the interior.

Upstairs, the property consists of three generous bedrooms, all bright and spacious, together with a main family bathroom. One of the bedrooms benefits from built-in wardrobes. The property also features electric heating throughout.

Rushbrooke Manor is ideally positioned approximately a 10-minute walk from Cobh town centre and is within close proximity to schools, shops, bus routes, and the train station, offering excellent convenience for everyday living.
